enchantments.tooltip: Insightful Deception +5: +5 Insight bonus to hit and +8 to damage for any hit that would qualify as a sneak attack.

Relentless Fury: While this item is equipped, any killing blows you strike against enemies may drive you into a furious rage, providing a 5% Enhancement damage bonus to your melee, ranged and unarmed attacks for 30 seconds. Slaying weaker opponents has a reduced chance of producing this effect.
Seeker +13: Provides a +13 Enhancement bonus to confirm critical hits, and a +13 Enhancement bonus to critical hit damage (before multipliers are applied).
Quality Combat Mastery +3: +3 Quality bonus to the DC to resist the character's Trip, Improved Trip, Sunder, Improved Sunder, Stunning Blow, and Stunning Fist attempts.
